brief: Te Manihera and Kereopa were martyred at Tūrangi in 1847. The story of their early missionary work in the Hāwera area and their subsequent dedication to set out on a dangerous preaching mission has long been remembered. They died after being shot as they approached the village of a tribal enemy. No utu was sought, and later their former adversaries created a mission base where many became Christians. The blood of the martyrs was the seed of the church.
